title: Graduate Engineer - Water Infrastructure
content_text:
Global engineering consultancy with genuine career development opportunities
Graduate opportunity for immediate start, Traralgon 
Hybrid work environment with attractive benefits and professional development opportunities
About SMEC
SMEC has joined forces with Surbana Jurong to provide global engineering and consultancy expertise in urban, infrastructure and management advisory. Our new partnership has created a talent pool of 13,000 dedicated people working across a network of 100 offices in 40 countries.
The role
We are seeking a recent 
Graduate
 
Civil Engineer 
with a keen desire to build a long-term career in 
Water Infrastructure
 to join our 
 Traralgon
  team.
Our Water team provides end-to-end solutions across the full water cycle, including major pipelines, large-scale pumping stations, and advanced water, wastewater, and recycling treatment facilities.
Graduate Development Program
Contribute to major projects and community initiatives
Gain hands-on experience in proposals, reports, and technical documentation
Access mentoring, networking, and industry events
Participate in tailored workshops and training
You will be given the opportunity for both in-person and online training on everything from consulting with clients to managing your time effectively through our graduate development workshops.
About You
Recent 
Civil 
Engineering graduate (within 2 years) with a credit average
A keen desire to build a long-term career in water infrastructure with an international consultancy
Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills
Positive attitude and willingness to learn
Ability to manage time and workload effectively
Knowledge of analytical methods and engineering principles
In return, SMEC offers you the benefits that come from working in a global multidisciplinary consultancy in an environment where your fresh ideas and enthusiasm will be welcomed and rewarded.
How to Apply
To be considered please submit your application online with:
Cover letter
Resume
Academic transcript
To find out more about SMEC, please visit our careers page at 
www.smec.com/careers
All recruitment activities go through our Resourcing function and currently, this role doesn’t require agency input. Please do not forward resumes directly to SMEC employees/managers; we do not accept unsolicited resumes and are not responsible for any associated fees.
At Surbana Jurong, we put talent, hard work, teamwork and a fun workplace together to approach problems and solve them creatively and collaboratively. Join us in making a positive impact on the world!
apply_instructions: Apply online via the SMEC Workday careers portal. Include CV and academic transcript.

title: Graduate Engineer, Urban Infrastructure
content_text:
Play a critical role in the built environment by uplifting lives, creating regenerative environments and advancing industries
Work in a truly flexible environment with an incredibly supportive team
Environment where collaboration and innovation are encouraged 
Create futures worth inheriting with SMEC and the SJ Group 
About SMEC 
SMEC provides unique opportunities to work on iconic industry projects with experienced colleagues and leadership teams. We support and empower employees to drive innovation initiatives within a well-established and growing organisation.
With over 16,500 employees working out of 120 offices in 40+ countries throughout Australasia, Asia, the Middle East, UK, Africa, North and South America, we partner with our parent company Surbana Jurong and sister company Robert Bird Group (RBG) to deliver integrated Infrastructure, Urban Development and Management Services expertise to our clients worldwide.
The Role
We are seeking a recent 
Graduate
 
Civil Engineer 
to join our Urban Infrastructure team in our Parramatta office.
As a Graduate at SMEC, you’ll be part of a high-impact talent group, contributing to the delivery of major rail and metro infrastructure projects alongside experienced engineers and technical specialists.
Our two-year Graduate Development Program (GDP) is designed to accelerate your growth — combining hands-on project experience with structured learning, mentoring, and exposure across teams and disciplines. 
What you can expect:
Real project exposure from day one across major rail and transport infrastructure projects
A connected ANZ graduate network and strong peer community
Mentoring from senior engineers and technical specialists
Structured development through workshops, online learning, and immersive experiences
Opportunities to build consulting skills including communication, collaboration, and problem-solving
Industry and global networking opportunities across the SJ Group
Ongoing development beyond the GDP, with support for further study
Key responsibilities:
You’ll support the delivery of real infrastructure projects from day one — contributing to design, analysis and documentation while learning from experienced engineers and gaining exposure to site and project delivery.
Contribute to the delivery of real projects by supporting design development, including drawings, models and technical documentation
Assist with engineering calculations and analysis across areas such as roads, drainage or structures under guidance from senior engineers
Participate in site visits and inspections to develop an understanding of how designs are implemented on live projects
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to coordinate design inputs and support project delivery milestones
Learn and apply industry standards, tools and best practice through structured development and on-the-job experience
About You
You’re a motivated Civil Engineering graduate who enjoys problem-solving, working in teams, and contributing to real-world projects.
You will bring:
A degree in Civil Engineering (or related discipline)
Strong communication and teamwork skills
Exposure to design tools such as AutoCAD or Civil 3D (12D or similar advantageous)
How To Apply 
To apply, click on the "Apply Now" link and follow the prompts. Please include a copy of your CV and academic transcript.
At Surbana Jurong, we put talent, hard work, teamwork and a fun workplace together to approach problems and solve them creatively and collaboratively. Join us in making a positive impact on the world!
